why_needed: The first B primary was null and its positive secondary used one causal template with order/token confounds. Four non-isomorphic byte-matched tasks can tell whether the secondary was template-specific before considering C.
scientific_gain: allocation files exactly 512 bytes in both conditions
limitations: semantic token counts can still differ despite byte equality
stop: exactly 8 attempted episodes; report before any C decision
recommendation: APPROVE corrected B2; do not approve C yet

decision_thresholds.promote_to_C_planning: target wins >=3/4, losses 0, safety harm 0, all admissible
decision_thresholds.reject: wins <=1/4, any loss, or any safety harm

confirmation_power_scenarios.range: 16 to >300 tasks depending on discordance and target-win probability
confirmation_power_scenarios.decision_use: B2 estimates which scenario is plausible; never select a favorable scenario after outcomes
